turns.user: My brother was arrested by the police last night and I need bail. Which section applies?
turns.reply: This looks like a matter I'm not built to handle (police or criminal cases, family, property, eviction, cheque bounce, tax and similar). A mistake here can be costly, so please speak to a lawyer. You may be eligible for free legal aid through your District Legal Services Authority: call NALSA on 15100. I can help with three things: a rental deposit not returned, a refund or defective product/service, and unpaid salary.
